design.text: Phase 3, multicenter, randomized, prospective, double-masked, vehicle-controlled, parallel arm study; subjects randomized 1:1 to lifitegrast 5% or vehicle administered twice daily in each eye for 12 weeks, stratified by inferior corneal fluorescein staining score and eye dryness score at baseline.

citations.quote: This was a Phase 3, multicenter, randomized, prospective, double-masked, vehicle-controlled, parallel arm study conducted in the US to evaluate the efficacy and safety of lifitegrast ophthalmic solution (5.0%) (hereafter referred to as lifitegrast) administered twice daily in each eye for 12 weeks.
Approximately 700 subjects were planned to be randomized 1:1 (approximately 350 per treatment arm) to receive either lifitegrast or vehicle.

population.text: Adult subjects with dry eye disease (DED) and a history of recent artificial tear use.

citations.quote: The study was conducted in adult male and female subjects with DED and a history of artificial tear

A Phase 3, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-masked and Placebo-controlled Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of a 5% Concentration of Lifitegrast Ophthalmic Solution Compared to Placebo in Subjects with Dry Eye Disease and History of Recent Artificial Tear Use

endpoint.text: Primary endpoint: mean change from baseline to Day 84 in the eye dryness score (EDS), a 0-100 point visual analogue scale (VAS).

citations.quote: The primary endpoint was mean change from baseline to Day 84 in eye dryness score (VAS).

To evaluate the efficacy of lifitegrast compared to vehicle in improvement of symptoms of DED as measured by the mean change from baseline to Day 84 in the EDS (0-100 point visual analogue scale [VAS], both eyes)
Of the 711 randomized subjects (vehicle: 356 subjects; lifitegrast: 355 subjects).

result.text: Lifitegrast achieved a statistically significant improvement in mean change from baseline to Day 84 in eye dryness score vs vehicle: treatment effect 7.16 (SE 2.096), 95% CI (3.04, 11.28), p=0.0007.

indication.text: Xiidra (lifitegrast ophthalmic solution) 5% is indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of dry eye disease (DED).

citations.quote: Xiidra™ (lifitegrast ophthalmic solution) 5% is indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of dry eye disease (DED).

target_moa.text: Lifitegrast is a lymphocyte function-associated antigen-1 (LFA-1) antagonist that binds LFA-1 and blocks its interaction with intercellular adhesion molecule-1 (ICAM-1), which may be overexpressed in corneal and conjunctival tissues in dry eye disease.

citations.quote: Lifitegrast binds to the integrin lymphocyte function-associated antigen-1 (LFA-1), a cell surface protein found on leukocytes and blocks the interaction of LFA-1 with its cognate ligand intercellular adhesion molecule-1 (ICAM-1). ICAM-1 may be overexpressed in corneal and conjunctival tissues in dry eye disease. LFA-1/ICAM-1 interaction can contribute to the formation of an immunological synapse
Lifitegrast is a novel small-molecule antagonist of lymphocyte function-associated antigen 1 (LFA-1; also known as CD11a/CD18 or \alpha L \beta 2)
